description: How often AI answers name the member's brand (visibility), recommend it, where it ranks (position) and the tone (sentiment), with change vs the previous period; the brand standings against tracked competitors; per-model visibility (ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews…); what AI praises and criticizes; brands AI names that aren't tracked. Same numbers as Kliqo's Answer audit and Insights. Use for "how visible are we in ChatGPT?", "who is winning?", "what does AI say about us?". Needs sign-in to Kliqo (read-only).

end_date.description: Exact end date (YYYY-MM-DD), today at the latest

model.description: Only this AI model's answers; leave out for the project's current models

project.description: Project name, domain or id; leave out for the workspace's current project

range.description: Date range, ending today in the project's time zone

start_date.description: Exact start date (YYYY-MM-DD), for example the 1st of a month; use with end_date instead of range
